hero.title: Experience Gwimake
hero.subtitle: An immersion with the Arhuaca community in the heart of the Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta.

experience.title: A Transformative Experience
experience.paragraph1: Immerse yourself in the heart of the Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta and share life with the Gwimake community. This is not just a tourist visit; it's an invitation to disconnect from the modern world and reconnect with the ancestral wisdom of the Earth.
experience.paragraph2: Learn about the Arhuaco worldview, participate in their daily rituals, share their food, and listen to their stories. You will leave with a renewed perspective and a deep respect for a culture that protects the heart of the world.

gallery.title: Follow our story
gallery.subtitle: Moments, stories, and wisdom shared from the heart of the world.

posts.alt: River with crystal clear water in the Sierra Nevada
posts.caption: The sacred water that cleanses and purifies our spirit. A gift from Mother Earth.

posts.alt: Arhuaca woman weaving a mochila bag
posts.caption: Weaving thoughts, weaving life. The art of the Arhuaca mochila.
The joy and future of our community in a smile.
The wisdom of our elders is the guide for our path.
The land gives us sustenance, we give it our care in return.
The sacred water that cleanses and purifies our spirit. A gift from Mother Earth.

testimonials.title: What Our Visitors Say
testimonials.subtitle: Stories of connection and transformation experienced in the heart of the Sierra.

items.quote: A life-changing experience. The connection with the land and the wisdom of the Gwimake community is something I will carry with me forever.
items.author: Ana Sofía R.

items.quote: The hospitality and warmth of the host family were incredible. I learned so much more than I expected. Highly recommended!
items.author: John Miller

items.quote: Disconnecting from the world to connect with the essential. Gwimake offers a space of peace, learning, and deep reflection. I will return without a doubt.
items.author: Isabella Schmidt
